content.text: ### Equity Compensation Eligible employees may receive stock option grants as part of their total compensation package. Grants are subject to a 4-year vesting schedule with a 1-year cliff. Details are provided in individual grant agreements. ## 5. Time Off \& Leave {#time-off} ### Paid Time Off (PTO) Northstar offers a flexible PTO policy. Full-time employees receive: * **Years 0-2:** 15 days PTO per year * **Years 3-5:** 20 days PTO per year * **Years 6+:** 25 days PTO per year PTO accrues monthly and may be carried over up to 5 days into the following year. Unused PTO beyond the carryover limit will be forfeited. ### Holidays Northstar observes the following paid holidays: * New Year's Day * Martin Luther King Jr. Day * Presidents' Day * Memorial Day * Independence Day * Labor Day * Thanksgiving Day * Day after Thanksgiving * Christmas Eve * Christmas Day * 2 Floating Holidays (employee choice) ### Sick Leave Employees accrue 1 hour of sick leave for every 30 hours worked, up to a maximum of 80 hours per year. Sick leave may be used for personal illness, medical appointments, or caring for a sick family member. ### Parental Leave **Birth/Adoption Leave:** 16 weeks paid leave for primary caregivers, 8 weeks paid leave for secondary caregivers.
